subject.title: [Bug]: 2 codex accounts, same machine, same docs, one has balloon startup cost

question: Should local stdio Codex app-server state remain per-agent by default, or should OpenAI OAuth profiles get account-scoped `CODEX_HOME` isolation to prevent cross-account cached context/state bleed?
rationale: Both choices affect persistent native Codex auth/session/plugin state and the recent `homeScope` model, so automation should not pick the storage contract without maintainer intent.

options.title: Account-scope OAuth homes
options.body: Approve per-auth-profile or per-account Codex homes for OAuth stdio launches, with explicit migration/reset/docs behavior and two-account proof before closing this issue.

options.title: Keep per-agent default
options.body: Treat the current per-agent home as intentional and investigate the cached-prefix symptom elsewhere before changing storage layout.

options.title: Add an opt-in recovery path
options.body: Keep the current default but add a documented doctor or setup recovery path for multi-account users who need isolated Codex state.

recommendation.title: Account-scope OAuth homes
recommendation.body: Approve per-auth-profile or per-account Codex homes for OAuth stdio launches, with explicit migration/reset/docs behavior and two-account proof before closing this issue.

likelyOwner.reason: This person authored and merged the most recent Codex home-scope work that defines the current default and docs boundary.
